findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.comment: There is observed to not be a Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM) present in the facility during today’s inspection. This was discussed with the PIC. Ensure that there are enough CFPMs to cover all hours of operation and food preparation.
findings.citation_text: 2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: There was observed to be ice that had been dumped in the handwashing sink at the bar. This was discussed with the PIC. Ensure that handwashing sinks are only used for their intended purpose of handwashing.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing.

findings.title: Single use/single service articles are properly stored and used.
findings.comment: FIRST REPEAT- The drinking straws in the bar area were observed unwrapped and stored in close proximity to consumers. CORRECTED- The PIC moved the containers of straws to be behind the bar counter. Ensure that unwrapped straws are either stored behind the counter where they are controlled by employees or purchase wrapped straws for consumers.
findings.citation_text: 4-904.11(A) Kitchenware and Tableware. (A) SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and cleaned and SANITIZED UTENSILS shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed so that contamination of FOOD- and lip-contact surfaces is prevented.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment:
The following nonfood contact surfaces are observed to be cracked and in need of repair:

1. The gaskets of the main preparation cooler on the cook-line. 
2. The gaskets of the silver freezer along the cook-line. 
3. The gaskets of the double-door cooler by the pizza preparation area. 
4. The gaskets of the pizza preparation cooler. 

Ensure that these gaskets are replaced and are maintained in good repair.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.11(A) Good Repair and Proper Adjustment. (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
The following physical facilities are observed to be in need of repair: 

1. SECOND REPEAT- The handwashing sink to the right of the cook-line is observed to be in need of being re-sealed. 
2. SECOND REPEAT- The table to the left of the dish machine is in need of being sealed to the wall. 
3. Observed a cracked tile on the floor of the cook-line in front of the prep cooler. 

Ensure that physical facilities are maintained in good repair. Ensure that all repairs are made to be smooth and easily cleanable.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used.
findings.comment: There was observed to be a phone charging on the top of the preparation cooler on the cook-line. There was also observed to be personal canned drinks in the double-door cooler in between trays of food for the facility. Discussed making sure to store personal items in a designated area to prevent contamination to food-contact surfaces and food for the facility. It is recommended to have a bucket on the bottom shelf of a cooler labeled “Personal” for employee food and drinks.
findings.citation_text: 6-403.11(A) Designated Areas. (A) Areas designated for EMPLOYEES to eat, drink, and use TOBACCO PRODUCTS shall be located so that FOOD, EQUIPMENT, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES are protected from contamination.
